modality_context: KO (Shifrut/Marson primary human CD8 T-cell CRISPR-KO screens); concordance rule: concordant = protective_lof
io_rationale: Inhibitory scaffold that tunes TCR signal strength. Knockdown/KO lowers the activation threshold and improves CAR-T potency; also a direct surface antigen in T-cell malignancies.

tractability.evidence: ChEMBL target CHEMBL3712888; cell-surface glycoprotein. Two CD5-binding immunotoxins in ChEMBL (max_phase 2) and a large active CD5 CAR-T/CAR-NK clinical wave.

genetic_evidence.rationale: CD5 region carries immune-trait associations; as an inhibitory receptor, reduced function is expected to raise immune tone (risk_lof for autoimmunity). Not cleanly genome-wide-significant/directional -> excluded from the directional funnel.

known_drugs.note: 15 active CD5-directed cell-therapy trials found (T-cell malignancies).

active_trials.note: Note: these target CD5+ tumor cells; using CD5 as an intracellular KO to boost the therapeutic T cell is a distinct, adjacent hypothesis.

safety_flags: CD5 KO/blockade may perturb T-cell selection/tolerance; fratricide considerations in CD5-directed cell therapy.
